reasoning_summary: The compiler incorrectly identified expressions involving the 'void' operator as having no side effects. Specifically, the 'void' operator was being treated as always returning a 'false' boolean value, which led the compiler to incorrectly assume that the entire expression (including the function call inside the void operator) was side-effect free and could be safely removed during optimization. The fix involved updating the logic to check if the operand of the 'void' operator has side effects before determining the boolean value of the expression.
